story:
NEPA Roofing Pros is a roofing contractor based at 36 Luzerne Avenue in West Pittston, Pennsylvania, operating as a division of READCORP Inc. under Pennsylvania Home Improvement Contractor registration #180500. Byron Read owns and runs the business, and he is the one who comes out to price the work.

We cover eight counties — Columbia, Lackawanna, Luzerne, Monroe, Wyoming, Wayne, Pike and Susquehanna — which in practice means Scranton and Wilkes-Barre and everything between and around them: Pittston, West Pittston, Kingston, Clarks Summit, and the smaller towns up and down the valley.

What we install is chosen for this climate rather than for a catalogue. Owens Corning Duration Series shingles with SureNail Technology on most residential work, standing seam and rib panel metal where a homeowner wants a roof they will not think about again, and flat, low-slope and EPDM systems on commercial buildings. The failure mode here is not hail, it is ice: meltwater refreezing at a cold eave and backing up under the bottom courses. Detailing the eaves, the flashing and the venting against that is most of the difference between a roof that lasts and a roof that stains a bedroom ceiling in February.

The rest of it is not complicated, and it is what our customers write about. We give you a written, itemised estimate — usually the same day you call — and the invoice matches it. Most residential roofs go on in a single day. When we leave, the debris is gone, the yard has been swept for nails, and we have walked the property with you. More than one review says it was as though we had never been there. That is the standard we are trying to hit every time.
